subject.title: Track OpenClaw seams needed for full imported-plugin parity

question: Which listed capabilities should become stable source-neutral OpenClaw plugin contracts, and which should remain intentionally unsupported?
rationale: Each proposal establishes a different lifecycle, ownership, compatibility, and security boundary that cannot be safely selected from Babelfish implementation details alone.

options.title: Stage independent contracts
options.body: Design and approve each seam separately, prioritizing narrow contracts that unlock faithful imports without duplicating host ownership.

options.title: Retain explicit gaps
options.body: Keep the affected contributions visibly unsupported until the corresponding OpenClaw internals are stable enough to expose.

options.title: Permit approximations
options.body: Allow Babelfish-specific substitutes even where their lifecycle or security semantics differ from the imported source.

recommendation.title: Stage independent contracts
recommendation.body: Design and approve each seam separately, prioritizing narrow contracts that unlock faithful imports without duplicating host ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue author assembled the cross-surface requirements and is the strongest available coordinator for routing each seam to its upstream owner.
